lifecycle: Exact-type checks and actual base Linux/material preflight before journal claim.
Fresh owner/source preparation; durable configuration/cgroup/create intent; original handle kept; watchdog before create; enforcement readback.
One-use bound FreshStartPermit consumed; exact retained start intent appended; single start command with no external admission callback between.
Independent native cleanup/delete acknowledgement and termination journal event before guest frame decode/output retention.
Bounded machine result plus full-wrapper durable finish/readback before publication; no packet/fence/publication/proof/release cycle.
Optional publication guarded separately; denial does not skip independent close/issuer/record/release.
Finally containment fallback if needed (never proof), capture close/watchdog stop, original handle close only after issuer path; no rootfs unmount.
remaining_gates: Independent read review before root-owned commit.
Actual isolated retained C22 Linux approval/reservation -> held runtime -> authenticated native proof -> atomic release with full loaded source scope.
Queued/pre-start cancellation release, reboot/power loss and process-loss-after-issuance-intent-before-packet remain unsupported; capacity retained.
Terminal replay has no existing-packet/DB replay hook in this ABI; it reports reconciliation_required without inventing observations or a new start.
tested_boundaries: Normal lifecycle ordering and private bytes absent from detached report.
Publication denial/invalid receipt, malformed/failed guest outputs, diagnostic failure, timeout/cancel/wait error, start ACK loss, durable finish failure.
Native observation failure: legacy fallback JSON never becomes proof/release; unexpected BaseException still attempts containment.
Nonterminal reconciliation never restarts; original create/profile and existing retained start required to close; missing start/identity retains capacity.
Terminal replay and changed boot issue zero runtime commands/re-signing; pre-start cancellation never invents a start.
Postfinish close/issuer/record/release errors retain terminal history; unknown release acknowledgement is not falsely projected as False.
Arbitrary exception messages filtered to bounded safe reasons.
